import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sales by product and size
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
product_size_data = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()
product_size_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E', '#A0522D'])
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.legend(title='Size')

ax2.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sale Amount ($)')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.setp(ax2.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45)

# 3. Customer age group distribution

age_group_counts = df['customer_age_group'].value_counts()

age_group_counts.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax3, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Group Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('')

# 4. Payment method and takeaway analysis
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack()
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#6A5ACD', '#9370DB'])
ax4.set_title('Sales by Payment Method (Takeaway vs Dine-in)', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.legend(['Takeaway', 'Dine-in'], title='Service Type')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
